# amisearchable.cc

amisearchable.cc is a free AI crawler checker and embeddable badge. Paste any public domain. The tool fetches that domain's robots.txt, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and sitemap.xml, then reports whether AI search and training crawlers are allowed, blocked, or unspecified.

## What the checker measures

Search and fetch bots decide whether a site can be retrieved for live AI answers:

- OAI-SearchBot
- ChatGPT-User
- PerplexityBot
- Claude-SearchBot
- Claude-User

The badge passes when none of those bots are blocked. Training crawlers are listed on the report but do not fail the badge:

- GPTBot
- ClaudeBot
- Google-Extended
- CCBot

File presence is informational and does not fail the badge:

- robots.txt — access rules for crawlers (also drives the pass/fail verdict)
- llms.txt — short site description for language models
- llms-full.txt — longer optional description
- sitemap.xml — URL map for crawlers that use it

This confirms crawler permission and whether those files exist. It does not guarantee the site will be cited in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or other AI answers. Citation also depends on content quality, competing sources, and each engine's ranking.

Anyone can check any public domain.

## Product

- Free: one-time check and a static embeddable badge
- Pro: daily re-check, email if status changes, same badge URL
- Badge URL: https://amisearchable.cc/badge/{domain}
- Report URL: https://amisearchable.cc/report/{domain}

## This site

amisearchable.cc allows AI search and training crawlers.

- https://amisearchable.cc/robots.txt
- https://amisearchable.cc/sitemap.xml
- https://amisearchable.cc/llms.txt
- https://amisearchable.cc/llms-full.txt
